Tomato___Early_blight.cause: Fungal infection (Alternaria solani) typically favored by warm temperatures and high humidity.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds. Practice crop rotation and ensure adequate spacing for airflow.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Remove affected leaves immediately. Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) at 10-day intervals.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g per litre of water or Chlorothalonil 75% WP.
Tomato___Early_blight.fertilizer_suggestion: Ensure balanced nutrition; avoid excessive nitrogen which can make plants susceptible.

Potato___Late_blight.cause: Water mold (Phytophthora infestans) thriving in cool, wet weather.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation and destroy cull piles.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Copper-based fungicides can be used preventatively in organic systems.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply systemic fungicides like Metalaxyl combined with Mancozeb.

default.prevention: Maintain field sanitation and ensure proper spacing and drainage.
default.organic_treatment: Neem oil spray is a good broad-spectrum organic preventative.
default.chemical_treatment: Consult local agriculture officer for specific broad-spectrum fungicide/bactericide.
